brief.symptoms: The SDK throws a DecodeError when trying to retrieve a token, indicating the JWT cannot be decoded.
brief.evidence: jwt.exceptions.DecodeError: It is required that you pass in a value for the "algorithms" argument when calling decode().
hints: The token manager attempts to decode a JWT without specifying the algorithm.
Look at the JWTTokenManager class - the decode call was changed in the diff.
When the token is fetched, the decode step now needs an algorithm and verify option.
brief.lesson: In PyJWT 2.x the `decode` function requires an explicit `algorithms` argument and the `verify_signature` option must be set to `False` when the signature verification is disabled.
